title: Supported derived generation of the constructible weak Serre coproduct heart
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$. Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed commutative ring isomorphic to one of a finite discrete commutative ring killed by a power of $\ell$, $\mathbf Z_\ell$, the ring of integers in a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\mathbf Q_\ell$, or a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. The condensed ring is $P\mapsto C(P,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Let $X$ be an arbitrary quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let $\mathcal A_X$ be ordinary uncompleted internal modules over the pullback $\Lambda_X$ on its small pro-etale site [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. A finite scalar local model is locally the pullback of a finite scalar presentation from the condensed point, and constructible means a finite constructible locally closed partition with such models on its strata [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $\mathcal P_X$ be the smallest replete class containing these constructible modules and closed under ambient kernels, cokernels, short exact extensions and all small coproducts. Let $\mathcal G_X$ be the supported derived hull defined in [lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation]: intersect all replete triangulated classes of $D(\mathcal A_X)$ closed under retracts, all small ordinary derived products, and termwise colimits of strict small filtered diagrams of complexes with a common termwise lower bound, and containing every supported finite scalar local model in degree zero. Supports are actual paths in finite qcqs open-closed trees: open arrows are quasi-compact and use extension by zero, and closed arrows have quasi-compact open complement and use ordinary direct image [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree]. Then every $M\in\mathcal P_X$ satisfies $M[0]\in\mathcal G_X$. No closed pair or torsion-rigidity hypothesis occurs. No filtered finite-complex-heart presentation is asserted. Empty schemes, zero modules and zero coefficient rings are included.

proof.text: Fix an admissible class $\mathcal H$ in the supported derived hull. Refine a constructible generator partition by a finite qcqs open-closed tree with actual factoring maps at the leaves. Pullback preserves finite scalar local models. The supported leaf restrictions are generators of $\mathcal H$. The exact open-closed localization sequences reconstruct the root by finite distinguished triangle extensions. Thus every constructible generator, placed in degree zero, belongs to $\mathcal H$. This step is now formalized by constructible_generation and indConstructible_mem_supported_derived_generation in the item module.

proof.text: The substantive remaining structural obligation is relation resolution for kernels and cokernels in the heart generated by the supported models. It must treat arbitrary morphisms between objects already obtained by weak Serre operations, not merely maps between two finite local models. On affine weakly contractible pro-etale charts use strict relation resolutions, products of their finite truncations and common-lower-bound filtered colimits to recover the actual abelian kernels and cokernels in degree zero. The existing finite-model image-generation theorem addresses the first finite-model relation step only. General iteration is not inferred from triangle closure and is not supplied by the refuted arbitrary-qcqs filtered finite-heart approximation.

proof.text: Translate the finite tree paths into the support chains of supported-hull pro-etale descent. Conversely, complete each finite chain by complementary qcqs sibling leaves; this identifies the same generators. The two common-bound clauses agree because IsStrictlyGE means that terms below the bound are zero. Descend the local relation constructions through that theorem, preserving the actual support functors. Short exact sequences yield extension closure by their distinguished triangles. Small coproducts in degree zero are filtered colimits of finite partial sums with common termwise lower bound zero. Therefore the degree-zero inverse image of the supported hull contains the generators and has kernels, cokernels, extensions and coproducts. Its repleteness follows from that of the defining classes. The minimality of $\mathcal P_X$ then yields $\mathcal P_X[0]\subseteq\mathcal G_X$. The zero-object arguments include empty schemes, zero modules and zero coefficient rings. The generator, extension, filtered-colimit and coproduct assertions are now proved separately in supportedGeneration_heart_colimits; only the relation and descent portion remains. The support-chain comparison and its transport of the declared pro-etale descent theorem are now formalized in supportedModelHull_iff and supportedImageHull_proetale_descent.

theorem weakSerre_mem_supported_derived_generation
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M) :
    supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
